annotations.text:
Wiring redesign — three tabs (Pipeline / Surface / Health) + one detail panel.
The single tall page becomes a scannable spine; the five scattered drawers collapse into one per-skill detail panel; Surface is promoted from a floating drawer to its own tab.
Click any skill → this panel. Slots & bindings / Compiled / History / Used-by in one place. Rebind is inline here (shown open on the domain slot), not a separate drawer.
